arcPosition: Third and last of the three quality tasks mapped onto this repo's CLAUDE.md. Task 1 = rules 5/1 (2026-07-28_1815). Task 2 = rules 3/4/7, SRP decomposition, merged PR #6 (2026-07-29_0837). Between them the capability-drift inventory ran (2026-07-29_1102), deliberately before this task because narrowing destroys the comparison surface.

keyFinding.summary: The engine is composed from YAML at runtime, so static C# reference counting measures entry points rather than the required public surface.
keyFinding.evidence: Every authenticator (6) is constructed only in AuthenticatorFactory.cs; every paginator (6) only in PaginatorFactory.cs. Selection is by authentication.type / pagination.strategy. grep -rln 'new <Type>(' src/ returns exactly one file for each of the 12.
keyFinding.consequence: Those families must be REGISTERED, not PUBLIC. Their contract is the YAML key. Composition is proven by a corpus conformance test, not by visibility.
keyFinding.retracts: An earlier '13 reachable vs 89 unreachable' framing, which measured names in consumer source only.

operations.narrow: the bulk — public -> internal. Non-breaking; reveals the surface that was already true.
operations.decompose: 3 items — IExecutionSink split; ExecuteOperationAsync overload chain -> request/options records; WorkflowRunner's two delegates -> IWorkflowHost. Breaking.
operations.add: 1 item — OAuth static_value/credential_key resolution + prefix TrimEnd() forward-port. Behavioural, not surface.
operations.remove: NOTHING. No type is deleted under this task (D7).

validationLegs.a: static C# reachability from the consumer — done, 13 entry points. INSUFFICIENT ALONE.
validationLegs.b: per-member traversal through public signatures — decides most cases. NOT YET COMPUTED; step S1.
validationLegs.c: YAML-driven dispatch — measured; argues FOR internal, proven by corpus conformance rather than visibility.

phases.title: API form: the three decompositions + the OAuth forward-port
phases.rationale: These reshape the surface being narrowed. Doing them first means one breaking release instead of two (D3).

phases.title: Narrowing: compute the required-public set, then narrow everything else

blockers.detail: The consumer set must be confirmed by the operator before anything is narrowed. YamlLocalRunner names 1 extra type; the old Collectors/YamlCollector compiles the engine as SOURCE so it is not visibility-constrained and must not be used as evidence; the Shared/SDK retirement in IntegrationInfra may add a host.
The InternalsVisibleTo decision needs the count of test files that fail to compile after narrowing. Narrow in a scratch branch, count, report, then decide. Do not add it by reflex.
